exact_statement: For every finite Boolean core g, integer L>=2 and every adaptive frontier obtained from its disjoint L-parity-block lift by querying only blocks with at least two unrevealed coordinates, exact matched spectral references have zero erasure, zero occupancy/calibration KL and constant complete CE H(g). Each remaining physical coordinate in block j has influence Inf_j(g). If J_F is mean remaining influence, total queried reach-weighted influence is L I(g)-J_F. From original capacity K L I(g), the erasure-plus-terminal-CE residual is unchanged K L I(g)-H(g), whereas explicitly earmarking K times queried influence leaves K J_F-H(g). Complete unwrapping has J_F=I(g). For any K>0 every nonconstant core has an unconditionally cheaply matched lift with L>=max(2,ceil(n*2^(n-1)/K)). Nonnegative remaining-influence residual at every such complete frontier is equivalent to FEI(K), exactly; a quotient bound H(g)<=K I(g)+lambda H(g), 0<=lambda<1, is equivalent to FEI(K/(1-lambda)). No source replacement can reduce an exact terminal CE below H(g).
hypotheses: Finite uniform Boolean cubes, disjoint parity blocks, at least one variable per block retained.
Exact normalized actual spectral reference including vacuum at every node; both physical children and all original bills retained.
Influence earmarking is an additional allocation rule, not an entropy or CE debit. K>0; lambda in [0,1).
